::: {#sol-absorption}

| $P$ | $Q$ | $P \land Q$ | $P \lor (P \land Q)$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | T | T | T |
| T | F | F | T |
| F | T | F | F |
| F | F | F | F |

The last column matches the $P$ column in every row,
so the rule grants access exactly to the administrators,
and the part about the office network changes nothing.
